title: Predetermination Thresholds, Decision Deadlines and Validity
content:
Where a treatment plan under an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider is worth more than the rider's threshold, a predetermination is obtained first. The threshold, the deadline for answering it and the period an approved answer holds good for are carried by the rider held.

| Rider | Treatment plan value above which a predetermination is required (USD) | Days within which a predetermination must be answered | Months an approved predetermination holds good for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 15 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0.00 | 15 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 1000.00 | 15 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 500.00 | 15 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 750.00 | 10 | 12 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 750.00 | 10 | 12 |

## The three terms

**The threshold** is the treatment plan value above which a predetermination must be obtained first, in USD.

**The decision deadline** is the calendar days within which a predetermination must be answered.

**The validity period** is the months an approved predetermination holds good for.

## Notes on the schedule

The four riders answering within 15 days carry a validity period of 6 months; the two answering within 10 days — the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider — carry 12 months.

The thresholds do not follow that division. The highest threshold in the schedule, 1000.00 USD, is carried by the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider; the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider each carry 750.00 USD, the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider 500.00 USD, and the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider 0.00 USD.
